subject: MAP: POC activation — credentialing, allowlist & peering window
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@cardinalsense.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC activation — credentialing, allowlist & peering window

Hi Elena —

Quick note to align on the environment items in the MAP so we can hit the Sep 10 pilot readiness date. We need three small things from CardinalSense this week to complete our activation checklist: 

- Org setup: confirm the org admin email and one service account owner (we need the service account name for the API key binding).
- API keys: we'll provision a scoped API key for eval traffic; please approve the key usage policy (attached).
- Network: IP allowlist (CIDRs) and confirmation if you want VPC peering (we support AWS peering and a transit VPC model).

I've attached a short checklist and a VPC peering template to make the ask lighter. If you approve, we can reserve a 2-hour peering window the evening of Sep 6 (UTC evening) to minimize impact.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm org admin + service account by Tue Aug 31 EOD PDT.
2) Share allowlist CIDRs by Wed Sep 1 so infra can create firewall entries.
3) Approve peering template and proposed Sep 6 window; we’ll send the peering playbook and a preflight checklist.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if that helps.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-map-poc-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 15KB)
Attachment: vpc-peering-template.txt (text, 4KB)

Thanks Jasmine,

This is great — apologies for the slow reply, we were in a vendor review offsite last week. Quick answers: 

- Org admin: elena.rossi@cardinalsense.ai (I'll be the admin).
- Service account: cs-redwood-svc (I'll get our infra to create; ETA Tue EOD).
- Allowlist: 52.23.128.0/24 and 18.205.0.0/16 (prod test range + secondary). We will confirm precise /24s once the account is created.
- Peering: we prefer peering (single-tenant) for performance—Sep 6 works for our AWS team; please send the playbook.

We'll aim to share the service account ARN and final CIDRs by Tue Aug 31 5pm PDT.

Best,
Elena

On the peering, please send any preflight checks you need us to run (route table, security groups, etc.).

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: prep for CardinalSense peering (Sep 6)

Team —

Per Elena's note, we have the green light from CardinalSense for Sep 6 evening peering. Action items for Redwood: 

- Marcus: prepare the peering endpoint, allocate a dedicated BGP ASN and a secondary subnet block for the test lane. Confirm required ingress ports and TTL.
- Neha: once Elena confirms the service account ARN, create the scoped API key binding and a short-lived token policy (48-hour validity for initial testing).
- Jasmine: coordinate the customer preflight and confirm the exact time window (they prefer 21:00–23:00 PDT).

I'll draft the peering runbook and send it to both teams by Wed morning. Keep this tight — we want zero surprises during the window.

— Karthik
Product Ops

Subject: Re: Internal: prep for CardinalSense peering (Sep 6)

Karthik/Jasmine —

Prep checklist from infra side: 
- Allocate BGP ASN: 64512 (reserved) — done.
- Redwood peering subnet: 10.240.100.0/24 reserved for demo lane.
- Expected inbound ports: 443 (API), 10250 (kube API if required for health checks). We'll only open 443 by default; health-check ports are optional.
- Routing: we'll accept static route announced by CardinalSense for 172.31.0.0/16; need confirmation of their announced prefix.
- Rollback: if route overlap or conflict detected, we tear down the peering and fail back to internet-routed test (no data loss).

I'll attach the peering config snippet in the runbook. Please confirm if we should use a test BGP community for this session.

— Marcus
Infra Engineering
